operations.GEN2_BOUNDARY_APPEND: checkpoint plus event: one admitted native event, or atomic joined component events at a new aligned tick. Extend every surviving history and retain original identities/targets/weights; compute only the new endpoints.
operations.GEN2_BOUNDARY_CONDITION: checkpoint plus explicit observed variable values. Retain all compatible complete assembly histories and their original relative weights.
operations.GEN2_BOUNDARY_INFORMATION: checkpoint and declared variables. Exact marginal/joint/conditional entropy and mutual information from the same retained history rows.
operations.GEN2_BOUNDARY_OPEN: Explicit registered components/readouts over one complete source-bound weighted assembly-history relation. Native account amounts and statistical weights remain separate.
operations.GEN2_BOUNDARY_RESUME: checkpoint only. Restore the source-bound complete assembly relation, observations and weights.
operations.GEN2_COMPILE: contract or native rho/blocks. Registered coordinates, event labels, receivers, admission and contact.
operations.GEN2_CONSTRUCTION_CHANGE: source, before/after values and contexts. Exact self, signed cross and changed-construction terms.
operations.GEN2_CONSTRUCTION_COMPILE: source typed accounts, incidence and instances; context and optional values. Pull back all instance operations into global accounts.
operations.GEN2_CUSTODY: contract records/source/visible/target/known_information/source_contract; action profile, encode, decode or fiber.
operations.GEN2_DECODE: observations; optional directions, initial_states, view, max_steps. Complete joint DAG always retained; partial calls return checkpoint.
operations.GEN2_DENSE_N72: Exact frozen source_instance identity; fresh1536-task native H14F dense N72, preserved artifacts and exact log count readout
operations.GEN2_ENCOUNTER: source transfer with clock/source/receiver identity and emissions. Causal reception.
operations.GEN2_ENCOUNTER_INVERSE: source transfer, observations, optional declared finite domain. Exact joint emission fiber.
operations.GEN2_FORMAL_LOG: terms: [prime, rational coefficient] pairs; optional compare_terms. Exact sign/comparison.
operations.GEN2_HD: value: exact rational; optional source_provenance. V6 HD and formal logarithm.
operations.GEN2_HD_PRIMITIVES: No inputs: exact h=2, d=3; ln2/ln3 coordinates, R, Theta, 9=8+1 and ln(9/8).
operations.GEN2_HISTORY_SUMMARY: Explicit source_binding, quantity, ordered positive-action points and directed native edges. Exact cumulative rise, fall, total variation and maximum upward excursion retain state/event links and all maximum ties. Missing/nonpositive actions retain explicit segments and gap status; they do not supply finite logarithms.
operations.GEN2_HISTORY_SUMMARY_APPEND: checkpoint plus new points and connecting edges. Reuse authenticated prior exact summaries and evaluate each appended edge once.
operations.GEN2_INVERSE_OPEN: contract or rho/blocks; explicitly typed frame or delta observations, declared event knowledge, initial conditions and reconstruction target. Complete finite state/history relation; supplied conditions are never inferred.
operations.GEN2_INVERSE_RESUME: checkpoint only. Authenticate source, implementation and original target/conditions/weights/probe history; restore the complete inverse session. Legacy GEN2_RESUME retains partial-DAG continuation with max_steps.
operations.GEN2_LI6_CONSTRUCTION: cover, assignment, rho, mask, hidden_loop, receiver and optional state/phases. Isotope-specific instance/source-account evaluation.
operations.GEN2_LI6_SITE_CYCLE: edges or sites/cycles. Joint exact reconstruction of all nine complex edge currents.
operations.GEN2_MOTION_RESUME: checkpoint plus optional max_writes; exact source/profile-bound continuation preserving original scale baseline, signed role histories and within-packet progress.
operations.GEN2_OBSERVATION_APPLY: checkpoint, sealed plan, choice_label and actual measured observation. Append native probe history while retaining original reconstruction target and every compatible original history. Explicit report_status MISSING preserves an actual admitted probe and every unfiltered original history; omission is invalid.
operations.GEN2_OBSERVATION_PLAN: sealed checkpoint; optional explicit choices and weights. Omitted choices uses registered available native/motion readouts automatically; exact information and all ties remain retained.
operations.GEN2_OBSERVATION_POLICY_APPLY: policy_checkpoint; optional available choice_label, or STOP; actual observation or explicit report_status MISSING. Follow measured branch preserving every compatible history and actual probe event.
operations.GEN2_OBSERVATION_POLICY_PLAN: checkpoint; horizon defaults to 2; optional declared choices and positive rational weights. Exact adaptive target information and transcript detail; later admission depends on prior answers. Original targets and histories persist.
operations.GEN2_OBSERVATION_POLICY_RESUME: policy_checkpoint only. Restore the sealed adaptive tree and current source-bound inverse session.
operations.GEN2_READOUT: strategy polynomial/radial/angular; exact source/amounts/options. Typed exact response.
operations.GEN2_READOUT_INVERSE: strategy, observations, optional domain/total. Complete finite fiber or exact linear affine family.
operations.GEN2_RESUME: checkpoint; optional max_steps/include_checkpoint. Continue source-bound complete DAG.
operations.GEN2_REUSE_STATS: Optional reset boolean. Execution telemetry only: actual new work, retained work and checkpoint verification; excluded from mathematical result/checkpoint identity.
operations.GEN2_RUN: contract or rho/blocks; initial phases and either prescribed program or motion request. Applicable sphere/log/signed role histories are automatic. Omitted motion.kind selects registered golden policy. max_writes supports partial packet execution.
operations.GEN2_SIGNED_LOG: Ordered contribution nodes VALUE/ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE with exact signed rational HD values, typed quantities and explicit positive references. Retain operands through cancellation; zero and undefined division are distinct.
operations.GEN2_SIGNED_LOG_RESUME: checkpoint plus optional append_nodes and optional result_id. Validate source binding and compute newly appended contribution nodes after authenticated restore.
operations.GEN2_SOURCE_BATCH: Native source contracts supported by the J4/T18 batch fabric; measured H14F/Ryzen/780M/T500 execution and custody.
operations.GEN2_TAU_ASSIGNMENT: reconstructed whitelist, declared recipe and arm; provenance separate. Observation -> role assignment -> exact response.
operations.GEN2_TAU_FEATURE_CATALOG: No inputs; per-feature operands, relation, operation, units, quantization, aggregation and provenance boundary.
operations.GEN2_TAU_REPLAY: assignment plus explicit readout parameters/normalization. Preserved learned predictions.
